scope: Implement one bounded canonical mining-tool equipment slice over the accepted P4 product lineage: equip and unequip an existing canonical Item Graph item through server-authoritative operations, replicate the exact equipped relation, restore it on reconnect, require the equipped mining tool for ResourceMining, and expose that canonical tool to the existing M7 presentation adapter without creating a second item, equipment, persistence, network authority or presentation truth.
required_outputs: Canonical equipment relation bound to existing Item Graph item identity
Server-authoritative equip and unequip command path
Invalid ownership and slot rejection evidence
Mining validation against exact equipped mining tool
Existing canonical P3 resource output preserved exact-once
M7 presentation accepts the canonical mining tool without a second presentation truth
Fresh evidence map, Reviewer PASS and Verifier PASS before P5 checkpoint proposal
stop_conditions: A second Item Graph or private equipment inventory truth would be required
A new persistence owner or private P5 save format would be required
A network protocol, authority, prediction, or reconciliation foundation change would be required; fail closed to NX/foundation decision
Any M7 production path other than scripts/runtime/networked_gameplay/m7/m7_item_graph_replica_adapter.gd would require mutation
A second pre-H0.3 runtime mutation worker would be required
The exact accepted P4 predecessor base cannot be proven
Production mutation escapes the bounded equipment/tool scope
risk_reasons: Composes Item Graph, multiplayer replication, reconnect recovery, ResourceMining and existing M7 presentation
Must prevent duplicate canonical equipment, item identity or presentation truth

design_brief.problem_statement: The accepted V0 product can mine and construct with canonical ore, but canonical items cannot yet become authoritative equipped tools consumed by gameplay rules and the accepted M7 presentation adapter predates the P5 mining-tool definition.
design_brief.current_behavior: P5 authority/replication/reconnect/mining focused gates are green, but full-regression M7 presentation rejects canonical item/tool/mining as M7_INVALID_CANONICAL_ITEM_IDENTITY.
design_brief.desired_behavior: A player equips one owned canonical mining-tool item through the server, all replicas preserve the same relation, reconnect restores it, mining validates it, and existing M7 presentation can project that same canonical item without creating another truth.
alternatives_considered: Remove the sandbox tool from canonical state
Bypass the unknown item in M7 presentation
Add the minimum item/tool/mining mapping and local presentation definition to the existing M7 replica adapter
design_brief.selected_design: Keep equipment authoritative in the M4 Item Graph and add only the missing canonical-definition mapping/presentation Definition in m7_item_graph_replica_adapter.gd. Do not mutate M7 command transport or create equipment state in M7.
design_brief.why_selected: It preserves one canonical item/equipment truth while making the existing presentation projection total over the new P5 item definition.
dependencies: existing M7 replica adapter is projection-only
expected_risks: M7 projection rejects new canonical definition
Equipped item duplicated between inventory and slot
Mining trusts presentation state instead of canonical relation
validation_plan: Apply only the M7 canonical definition mapping/Definition repair
Run M7 playable networked playground exact-head
